attributes.board_name: Nevada Board of Examiners for Marriage and Family Therapists & Clinical Professional Counselors

rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing education related to the field of practice; Board CEU approval available for events/providers; teaching (2 CE hours per hour taught, max 20), graduate courses (max 15), board meetings (max 4), community meetings (max 6)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Prorated by original issue date in the period: e.g. issued Jul-Dec of the 1st year 30 h; Jan-Jun of the 2nd year 20 h; Jul-Dec of the 2nd year 10 h (ethics/suicide reduced to 2 h each, CDEI stays 6 h).
rules.audit_note: Keep CEU records at least 3 years.

topics.who: All; ethics in MFT/clinical professional counseling
All; cultural competency and diversity, equity and inclusion (NRS 641A.260)

rules.notes: Licenses expire January 1 every other year (board: biennial cycle on even-numbered years); fee due by Dec 31. Max 20 h non-interactive/distance; at least half live or interactive webinar.
rules.rule_quote: Pursuant to NAC 641A.131, to maintain licensure, a Marriage and Family Therapist or a Clinical Professional Counselor must complete 40 hours of continuing education during the biennial license period…
